lessons.mistake: Treating ExceptionStream TID and the stack-owner TID as one context would create a false call chain.
lessons.rule: Keep exception context and stack ownership separate whenever ESP/EBP fall outside the ExceptionStream thread range.

lessons.mistake: A cross-version movzx versus movsx difference can be mistaken for the actual producer when the raw byte is absent.
lessons.rule: Keep signedness as not established until the failing raw value and accepted range are captured.

lessons.mistake: A capped search can look complete while omitting most of the crash corpus.
lessons.rule: Every family count must carry a complete denominator, skipped count, SHA-256 deduplication and positive control.

lessons.mistake: A post-failure AUTOSAVE can be read as if it were the exact runtime state.
lessons.rule: Mark post-failure saves as derived and do not infer a crash-time cell without a version-bound decoder.

lessons.mistake: Editing protected crash artifacts before all checks would invalidate the canonical case contract.
lessons.rule: Build and verify every report and sidecar in canonical staging; promote only after a fresh case contract.

lessons.mistake: Treating an RVA, a PE file offset, or a minidump descriptor position as the physical DMP offset can make the displayed bytes look plausible while the proof points at the wrong file location.
lessons.rule: Map a requested VA through the parsed MemoryList or Memory64List range, compute file_offset=range_file_offset+(VA-range_start), bind the DMP size and SHA-256, and re-read the exact target bytes before accepting a proof.

lessons.mistake: Free-form dump output and a manually asserted matched flag can be mistaken for machine evidence.
lessons.rule: Dump queries must return typed captured/not_captured/ambiguous states with range provenance and a hash-bound address-proof fragment; prose and manual matched fields never satisfy the gate.

lessons.mistake: Promoting a corrected upstream proof while leaving evidence, quality gates, manifests, HTML, archives, or snapshots in place creates a mixed-revision case.
lessons.rule: Compute the dependency closure from every changed root, atomically promote exact staged sidecars, invalidate every stale derived output, and never invalidate immutable TXT, DMP, or .extra.html inputs.

lessons.mistake: Repeating prepare, commit, or push after an already pushed cycle is waiting only for Pages verification can combine old remote artifacts with new local edits.
lessons.rule: Recognize the old cycle only from its schema-4 state, pending Pages handoff, self-digested snapshot, direct private commit lineage, committed source blobs, and Git attestation; then perform only Pages verification, clipboard copy, and journal closure. Publish later local changes in a separate cycle.

lessons.mistake: Allowing arbitrary JSON names in a staging handoff turns a narrow correction path into an uncontrolled case rewrite.
lessons.rule: Promotion accepts only explicit canonical basenames or audited evidence/address prefixes; each newly allowed sidecar must have a denial regression for an arbitrary neighbour.

lessons.mistake: Using current working-copy quality artifacts to acknowledge a historical sealed cycle turns intentional later corrections into false corruption and can encourage replay of an already pushed cycle.
lessons.rule: A historical sealed tail must verify every recorded quality artifact by path, size, and SHA-256 against immutable blobs in the cycle private commit. Current-cycle acknowledgement remains strict against the working copy and is never reused for historical closure.

regressions.closing_condition: Three exhaustive scans pass with skipped=0 and positive control present.
All machine contracts validate without errors.
All named HD_HOTA and HotA sites are enumerated with zero skipped.

regressions.test: matched-build A/B reproduction with positive control
regressions.closing_condition: Original path fails and fixed path survives with complete telemetry on matched binaries.

regressions.test: full dump plus watchpoint on first invalid slot writer
regressions.closing_condition: The first invalid terrain byte or NULL slot writer is identified with module and stack.

regressions.test: address_proof.py selftest plus all current corpus address-proof*.json checks
regressions.closing_condition: MemoryList physical offsets, DMP identity, and target bytes validate for every current proof.

regressions.test: dump_query typed contract on real DMP, synthetic MemoryList, and synthetic Memory64List
regressions.closing_condition: Captured and not_captured results carry exact stream, range, physical offset, bytes, and hashes.
A false schema-2 physical offset is rejected and schema-1 data is explicitly marked legacy-unverified.
Downstream closure is hash-bound; replace/create/delete operations roll back together and immutable inputs cannot be invalidated.
A sealed Pages tail bypasses tests/prepare/rebuild/commit/push and closes only after verification and clipboard journal marking.
lessons.json is allowed while arbitrary.json, raw TXT/DMP, and .extra.html remain denied.

Intentional local drift is accepted only when every original quality artifact matches its immutable private-commit blob; a missing or mismatched blob blocks closure before clipboard or state mutation, with no prepare, commit, or push.

unresolved.question: What exact terrain byte selected the NULL slot?
unresolved.capture_command: Break before 0x0101BE5A and log cell+4, count, shift, slot and DEF.
unresolved.positive_control: Log a valid terrain cell on the same binary and map level.
unresolved.closing_condition: Failing raw value and accepted range are both recorded.

unresolved.question: What first produced the NULL land-def table entry?
unresolved.capture_command: Set a watchpoint on the selected slot after initialization and capture every writer/free.
unresolved.positive_control: Trace an adjacent valid slot through the same initialization and update path.
unresolved.closing_condition: The first transition to NULL is tied to an instruction, module, stack and object generation.

unresolved.question: Would clamping z before A0_Get_CellParams change the activating visibility bit?
required_evidence: paired return values for z=-1 and z=0
unresolved.capture_command: Invoke the visibility helper twice on the same cell with only z varied and log AL.
unresolved.positive_control: Repeat on a cell where both levels are known valid.
unresolved.closing_condition: The branch result is shown equal or different under a one-variable test.

unresolved.question: Can the reported map state reproduce the crash before instrumentation changes semantics?
unresolved.capture_command: Run the preserved scenario on matching HD/HotA binaries and capture full telemetry.
unresolved.positive_control: Run a nearby valid terrain path with identical settings.
unresolved.closing_condition: At least one failing original run and one successful control are captured.
